text: Separate recovered rules from new choices
Distinguish known workshop rules from later design choices.

The available workshop material records mission categories, rating equations and the broad shape of the auction. It does not supply a complete historical card inventory or all procedural details needed to operate a digital auction. A later engineering design fills some of those gaps deliberately. Those additions should be identified as newly chosen game rules, not represented as historical facts.

items: The workshop description includes ten category positions in a round and a limit of two wins per team. Bid ties and the handling of unsold lots remain unresolved in the original material.
